title: {Syn} PageRank Treated Links Like Votes With Memory
content:
PageRank models a web surfer who follows links and occasionally jumps to a random page. A page becomes important when important pages link to it.

The idea helped make web search scalable because it used the graph structure of the web as a ranking signal, not just the text on each page.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
